# Security Policy

## Reporting Vulnerabilities
Please report security vulnerabilities to [privacy@hex-yt-intel.com]. 

## Policy on Automated Abuse
We do not permit automated scraping, harvesting of data, or automated reuse of our GitHub Actions workflows. Any automated system detected abusing our resources will be blocked and reported to GitHub Abuse. 

Do not attempt to probe or bypass our security controls (HMAC, Auth, Rate Limiting).
